items.headline: NFL Week 7 uniforms: Alternates galore as Texans go battle red, Lions all-black
items.description: Here's a look at what each NFL team is wearing in Week 7, led by alternate looks from Houston, Detroit and Dallas.

items.headline: Bears QB Caleb Williams leads NFL Week 7's best arrivals
items.description: NFL stars continue to turn game-day arrivals into their own weekly fashion showcase.

items.headline: C.J. Stroud powers Houston Texans vs New York Giants as J.J. McCarthy starts
items.description: — The New York Giants know better than to underestimate the Houston Texans entering Sunday’s matchup even though they’ve won just two games this season.

items.headline: JJ Watt lands new deal as full-time CBS lead analyst replacement for Tony Romo
items.description: J.J. Watt will be the full-time lead NFL game analyst for CBS Sports, filling the role previously held by Tony Romo.

items.headline: Kyrie Irving explains offer to pay Al-Shaair's eye black fine
items.description: Azeez Al-Shaair was fined after he wore the name Hind Rajab on his eye black during the Texans' season opener.

items.headline: Texans' Tank Dell says he won't fear being hit in return Sunday against Giants
items.description: Texans WR Tank Dell said he is "ready to get tackled" on Sunday when he returns for his first game since suffering a gruesome knee injury in December 2024.
